full_prompt_en: A square cinematic interior photograph shows a lone seated figure facing a large window in a dim, worn room. The upper and side walls are almost black green, their details visible only as faint planes and a framed picture on the left. The window spans most of the back wall, divided by vertical mullions into broad blue-green panes. Beyond the glass, dense mist or rain hides the distance; a low gray horizontal surface and one small indistinct dark shape appear near the bottom of the view. The seated figure is placed to the right of center in a deep chair, seen mostly as a dark side silhouette against the cold window light. A low table stands between the seating and the window, holding a small bright monitor or screen near its left end and scattered low objects along its top. On the far left, a shaded lamp creates a tiny amber glow above another dark chair. A leafy plant near the right window edge is partly swallowed by shadow. The floor across the foreground is wet or highly glossy, mirroring the vertical window light in irregular teal streaks and holding a warmer reflection near the lamp. This reflective surface provides visible texture and depth beneath the otherwise still furniture. Cool diffuse light enters from the window, lighting the central floor and leaving the corners in deep shadow; the small lamp and screen add local warm and white points without illuminating the room evenly. Fine haze softens the outdoors, while the interior silhouette remains firm. The overall composition is quiet but unsettled, using a wide cold window, one dark figure, and low reflected light to create suspense through absence and distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感室内照片描绘一名独坐者在昏暗旧房间里面对大窗。上方和侧墙几乎是黑绿色，细节只以微弱平面和左侧一幅带框画呈现。大窗占据后墙大部分，由竖框分成宽阔蓝绿色玻璃。玻璃之外浓雾或雨遮住远处；窗景底部附近有低矮灰色水平面与一个不明的小深色形状。坐者在中央偏右的深椅里，大多以冷窗光前的深色侧面剪影出现。座椅与窗之间放着矮桌，左端有一台小型明亮显示器或屏幕，桌面还散着几件低矮物品。最左侧一盏带罩灯在另一张深色椅子上方制造一小点琥珀光。右侧窗缘附近一株叶类植物部分被暗影吞没。横贯前景的地面潮湿或非常光亮，以不规则青绿色条痕映出竖向窗光，灯附近还留有较暖倒影。这块反光表面在静止家具下提供可见肌理与纵深。冷漫射光从窗进入，照亮中央地面，让角落处于深影；小灯和屏幕加入局部暖色与白色光点，却没有均匀照亮房间。细雾柔化户外，室内剪影仍坚实。整体构图安静却令人不安，以宽阔冷窗、一个深色人物与低位反光，通过缺席与距离营造悬念。
style_prompt_en: A cinematic low-key treatment uses a broad cold light source behind a mostly dark foreground. Deep green-black and charcoal occupy the walls and side areas, while blue-green illumination forms a large central plane and breaks into uneven reflections below. Small amber and pale white points remain isolated within the shadows, giving the scene a restrained contrast in temperature. Atmospheric haze suppresses distant detail; closer silhouettes and vertical divisions remain more definite. A glossy lower surface pulls limited light across the frame without making the surrounding areas bright. Illumination is diffuse from behind, so objects read as dark masses with slight rim light and little direct facial or surface detail. The composition is spacious yet enclosed, its tension coming from a quiet foreground, a bright inaccessible distance, and asymmetrically placed small light sources.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感低调处理在大块暗前景后设置宽阔冷光源。深绿黑与炭色占据侧面和围合处，蓝绿色照明形成中央大平面，并在下方碎成不均匀倒影。少量琥珀与淡白亮点孤立在阴影里，带来克制的色温反差。空气雾气压低远处细节；近处剪影与竖向分格较为明确。光亮下方表面将有限的亮光拉过画框，却不使周围变亮。照明从后方漫射，使形体呈深色量块和轻微轮廓光，直接可见的表面细节很少。构图宽敞却受围合，紧张感来自安静前景、明亮却不可到达的远处，以及不对称分布的小光源。
theme_en: A lone seated figure watches a foggy view through a large window in a dim room
theme_zh: 昏暗房间里，一名独坐者望着大窗外的雾景
name: Tense atmosphere
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
